/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

files = ['app.py', 'config.py', 'formatting.py', 'stats.py', 'tests/test_report.py']
probe = '''from app import report
samples = [('empty', []), ('populated', [2, 4]), ('singleton', [0]), ('fractional', [-1, 2])]
for label, values in samples:
    for mode in ['omitted', None, False, True]:
        kwargs = {} if mode == 'omitted' else {'detailed': mode}
        try:
            result = repr(report(values, **kwargs))
        except Exception as exc:
            result = f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
        print(f'{label}, detailed={mode"'!r}: {result}'"')
'''
for label, prefix in [('HEAD a21036447ee7843887ddbaff82408db6e044b053', 'HEAD:'), ('staged index', ':')]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='batch-report-review-') as directory:
        for path in files:
            target = pathlib.Path(directory, path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', prefix + path]))
        print(label, flush=True)
        tests = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests'], cwd=directory, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print(tests.stdout, end='', flush=True)
        print('test exit:', tests.returncode, flush=True)
        probe_result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-c', probe], cwd=directory, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print(probe_result.stdout, end='', flush=True)
        print('probe exit:', probe_result.returncode, flush=True)
PY"

arguments.content: Default-mode activation can introduce a regression without changing the faulty helper. In the batch-report review (base a21036447ee7843887ddbaff82408db6e044b053, staged config.py), switching DETAILED_REPORT from False to True makes report([]) and report([], detailed=None) raise ZeroDivisionError. Both returned 'Items: 0' at the base; explicit detailed=True already failed. The four existing tests pass at both revisions because empty input is tested only with detailed=False. Review default switches with a cross-product of default/explicit overrides and boundary inputs, and attribute newly exposed default-path failures separately from inherited opt-in defects. Preserve count-only summaries for empty inputs by omitting mean computation, rather than inventing a zero mean.
